stylePrompt: Use the declared styleFamily for each item and choose subjects from people, communities, animals, plants, landscapes, weather, tools, vehicles, buildings and everyday objects according to the scene. Keep one coherent style inside each image while varying styles across the batch. Shared constraints: mature learner-facing art direction, landscape 3:2 composition, a clear focal action or relationship, no in-image teaching text, and no live-action or realistic-human impression. When people appear, every readable foreground or midground face must have clearly rendered natural eyes, a nose, a mouth and a scene-appropriate expression. Never use blank oval faces, featureless masks, mannequin heads or shadows that erase the facial features. Vary age, skin tone, facial structure, body type, hairstyle, clothing, ability and occupation naturally. No realistic skin pores, photographic faces, stock-photo staging, logos, watermarks, readable interfaces, chibi proportions or glossy toy rendering.

items.sentenceEn: Neighbors work together to establish a community garden.
items.sentenceZh: 邻居们共同建立一座社区花园。
items.scene: Adults transform a clearly empty urban lot into the first organized beds of a new community garden, setting the boundary, planting the first seedlings and raising a simple tool shelter together. The visible transition from unused ground to a durable shared place communicates establishment.
items.altText: 邻居们在空地上划分花圃、种下幼苗并搭建工具棚，建立社区花园。

items.sentenceEn: It was nice of her to share the umbrella.
items.sentenceZh: 她愿意分享雨伞，真是友好。
items.scene: On a rainy street, an adult notices a stranger getting wet and warmly moves her large umbrella so both people are sheltered. The recipient's relieved smile and the giver's considerate expression make the kind gesture unmistakable.
items.altText: 雨中，一位女士主动把雨伞移向陌生人，让两人一起避雨。

items.sentenceEn: The engineers test the bridge model in a wind trial.
items.sentenceZh: 工程师们在风力试验中测试桥梁模型。
items.scene: Two adult engineers observe a small bridge model inside a transparent wind-testing chamber as ribbons and airflow stream around it. Spare prototype pieces and measuring tools show this is a controlled trial rather than a finished bridge.
items.altText: 工程师在透明风洞中对一座小型桥梁模型进行试验。

items.sentenceEn: The expert repairs the complex clock mechanism.
items.sentenceZh: 专家修理复杂的钟表机械装置。
items.scene: An experienced adult clockmaker confidently repairs an intricate open clock mechanism with a fine tool while two apprentices watch attentively. The expert's practiced precision and the difficult array of gears establish specialized mastery.
items.altText: 经验丰富的钟表匠精确修理复杂齿轮，两名学徒在旁观察。

items.sentenceEn: Wildflowers cover the hillside in spring.
items.sentenceZh: 春天，野花覆盖了山坡。
items.scene: A hillside awakens after winter with melting snow patches, fresh green grass, blossoming trees and abundant colorful wildflowers under gentle rain and sunlight. Migrating birds return above the renewed landscape.
items.altText: 积雪消融的山坡长满青草与野花，树木开花，候鸟归来。

items.sentenceEn: The architecture firm reviews a new building model.
items.sentenceZh: 这家建筑公司审查一座新建筑的模型。
items.scene: A diverse team of adult architects gathers in a professional studio around one detailed building model, comparing plans without readable text and making coordinated design decisions. Shared workspace, specialist tools and group collaboration communicate a firm.
items.altText: 一家建筑公司的团队围绕建筑模型共同审查设计。

items.meaningZh: 民主人士；民主主义者；民主党党员
items.sentenceEn: The Democrat answers questions at a local town hall.
items.sentenceZh: 这位民主党人在当地市民大会上回答问题。
items.scene: A neutral civic scene shows an adult Democratic politician at floor level listening to and answering a diverse circle of local residents in a town hall. Use a simple blue lapel pin with no symbol, no flags, slogans, party logos, cheering crowd or persuasive campaign imagery.
items.altText: 一位民主党政治人物在市民大会上与当地居民平静交流。

items.sentenceEn: The family listens to the weather report on the radio.
items.sentenceZh: 这家人通过收音机收听天气预报。
items.scene: Three adults in a cozy kitchen lean toward one prominent tabletop radio while storm clouds gather outside the window. Curved visual sound waves emerge from the speaker, with no readable dial markings or text.
items.altText: 三位家人在厨房里围着桌面收音机收听天气预报。

items.sentenceEn: We visit our friends at their new home.
items.sentenceZh: 我们去朋友的新家拜访他们。
items.scene: Two adult visitors carrying a small overnight bag and a houseplant arrive at the open doorway of a new home, where two resident friends warmly welcome them inside. The threshold, arrival gifts and greeting clearly communicate a visit.
items.altText: 两位访客带着礼物来到朋友的新家，在门口受到欢迎。

items.sentenceEn: Good management keeps the hotel running smoothly.
items.sentenceZh: 良好的管理使酒店顺畅运转。
items.scene: At the center of a hotel lobby, an adult operations manager coordinates the front desk, housekeeping and luggage team using a simple icon-only board. Each group moves efficiently toward a different task while guests are calmly served.
items.altText: 酒店运营负责人协调前台、客房与行李团队，使各项工作顺畅进行。

items.sentenceEn: The cyclist turns aside to avoid the deep puddle.
items.sentenceZh: 骑车人转向一旁，避开深水坑。
items.scene: An adult cyclist visibly steers along a dry curved path around one deep roadside puddle while the original straight path would have crossed the water. Body lean, curved tire track and safe clearance make avoidance unmistakable.
items.altText: 骑车人沿弯曲路线转向，避开前方的深水坑。

items.meaningZh: 想像；设想；猜测；想像起来
items.sentenceEn: She can imagine the empty attic as a bright studio.
items.sentenceZh: 她能想象空阁楼变成明亮的工作室。
items.scene: An adult stands in a dim empty attic holding a paintbrush and smiles thoughtfully while a soft translucent imagined version of the same room appears around her as a bright art studio full of canvases and plants. Present reality and imagined possibility remain clearly distinct.
items.altText: 女子站在空阁楼中，身边浮现出它变成明亮画室的想象景象。

items.sentenceEn: We will eat dinner on the rooftop tonight.
items.sentenceZh: 今晚我们将在屋顶吃晚餐。
items.scene: At blue-hour twilight, three adult friends prepare a rooftop dinner table beneath the newly visible moon and first stars, lighting one lantern as the city transitions from sunset to night. The immediate evening setting communicates tonight.
items.altText: 暮色降临、月亮初升时，三位朋友在屋顶准备当晚的晚餐。

items.sentenceEn: The hikers stop beneath a huge waterfall.
items.sentenceZh: 徒步者们停在一座巨大瀑布下方。
items.scene: Two tiny adult hikers stand on a viewing ledge beneath an immense waterfall that fills most of a towering canyon wall. The dramatic scale contrast between people, trees and falling water makes huge unmistakable.
items.altText: 两名显得很小的徒步者站在占据整面峡谷的巨大瀑布下。

items.meaningZh: 球；舞会；球状物；捏成球形
items.sentenceEn: The red ball rolls across the grass.
items.sentenceZh: 红球滚过草地。
items.scene: One bright red rubber ball rolls across a green park lawn, with curved motion lines and a small bounce shadow. An adult player reaches toward it in the background, while no other balls appear.
items.altText: 一个鲜红色的球在公园草地上滚动。

items.meaningZh: 完成；结束；末道漆；磨光；完美
items.sentenceEn: She places the last tile to finish the mosaic.
items.sentenceZh: 她放入最后一块瓷砖，完成马赛克作品。
items.scene: An adult craftsperson carefully places one final colored tile into the only remaining gap of a large nearly complete mosaic. A tray beside her is now empty and the completed pattern closes perfectly around the last piece.
items.altText: 工匠把最后一块瓷砖放进马赛克唯一的空缺中，完成图案。

items.sentenceEn: You can build the simple shelf yourself.
items.sentenceZh: 你可以自己搭建这个简单的架子。
items.scene: One adult alone in a home workshop proudly assembles a simple wooden shelf with hand tools, with no helpers present. A nearby instruction sheet uses pictures only, and the person's independent effort is the clear focus.
items.altText: 一位成人独自在家庭工作间用手工工具搭建木架。

items.meaningZh: 理论；学说；原理；意见；推测
items.sentenceEn: The scientist uses a model to explain her theory.
items.sentenceZh: 科学家用模型解释她的理论。
items.scene: An adult scientist presents a tabletop model in which small planets follow glowing elliptical paths around one star, while a projected sky behind it shows the same predicted arrangement. The matching conceptual model and observation communicate a theory without formulas or labels.
items.altText: 科学家用行星轨道模型解释一种与天空观测相符的理论。

items.sentenceEn: The new bridge has a positive impact on the village.
items.sentenceZh: 新桥对村庄产生了积极影响。
items.scene: A new footbridge connects a once-isolated village to a market across the river; villagers now carry produce easily, children cross safely and both riverbanks are active. A faint inset shows the former difficult boat crossing, linking the bridge to its visible positive impact.
items.altText: 新桥连接村庄与河对岸市场，人们安全往来，显现积极影响。

items.sentenceEn: The dog will respond to its owner's whistle.
items.sentenceZh: 这只狗会对主人的口哨作出回应。
items.scene: In a park, an adult owner whistles and raises one hand; a dog that had been facing away immediately turns its head, perks its ears and runs back toward the owner. Curved sound marks and the dog's changed direction show a direct response.
items.altText: 主人吹口哨后，原本背对着的狗转身跑回来作出回应。
